operators.name: sum_channels_forward
semantics: Performs torch.sum(x, dim=1, keepdim=True) on the input tensor.
Reduces over the channel dimension C, keeping the dimension with size 1.
Supports arbitrary strides; the kernel should handle non-contiguous inputs by reading according to strides.
Output shape is [N,1,H,W] with the same N,H,W as input.

operators.name: expand_channels_forward
semantics: Performs x.expand(-1, channels_factor, -1, -1) on the input tensor.
The result is a view with stride 0 along the expanded channel dimension, but the custom op must materialize a contiguous tensor.
If channels_factor == 1, the output may be a simple contiguous copy.
Supports arbitrary strides on the input; the kernel should read according to strides and write contiguous output.
Output shape is [N, channels_factor, H, W].

operators.name: pixel_shuffle_forward
semantics: Performs nn.PixelShuffle(upscale_factor)(x) with r=upscale_factor.
The operation is equivalent to: reshape [N, C/(r^2), r, r, H, W] -> permute [N, C/(r^2), H, r, W, r] -> reshape [N, C/(r^2), H*r, W*r].
Assumes C is divisible by r^2; the reference model ensures this.
Supports arbitrary input strides; the kernel should read according to strides and write contiguous output.
Output shape is [N, C/(r^2), H*r, W*r].
